$description: Mellow design tokens. Source of truth for the Slint desktop client, the Android client and the admin web UI. Format: W3C Design Tokens Community Group (string values for colours, dimensions and durations). See DESIGN.md section 3.

ref.$description: Tier 1. Raw palette values with no meaning. Only semantic tokens (tier 2) may reference them. Dusk steps are named by their OKLCH lightness x 1000 (hue 322, low chroma: a plum-tinted grey); the other families keep ordered, arbitrary numbers.

160.$description: Dark ground: the window behind the cards; server rail and channel sidebar in the classic layout.

200.$description: Dark inset: form fields and code blocks; the ink of text on warning fills.

205.$description: Dark navigator card and side sheet, one step above the ground.

235.$description: Dark sheet: the conversation, settings content; rows on the ground when hovered; the user card. Light heading text and unread pill.

258.$description: Dark message hover on the sheet.

272.$description: Dark popovers and dialogs (one step above the sheet).

340.$description: Dark decorative divider and sheet hairline.

430.$description: Dark quote bar and reply spine; dark secondary button fill.

440.$description: Light secondary text; light secondary button fill on hover.

480.$description: Dark secondary button fill on hover; dark disabled text.

500.$description: Light muted text; light secondary button fill.

530.$description: Light channel-muted text and offline dot.

620.$description: Form field outlines in both themes (3:1).

660.$description: Dark offline dot; dark channel-muted text.

715.$description: Dark muted text; light disabled text.

865.$description: Dark normal text (kept below pure white against halation on dark surfaces).

932.$description: Light row hover on the ground.

962.$description: Light ground: server rail, channel sidebar, member list; light composer.

972.$description: Dark heading text; light inset fields and code blocks.

985.$description: Light message hover on the sheet.

300.$description: Mellow brand accent. Dark accent fill and dark mention bar.

950.$description: Text and icons on every apricot fill, both themes.

wash-dark.$description: apricot.300 at 8 % over grey.700, flattened. Dark mention highlight.

wash-light.$description: apricot.300 at 12 % over grey.0, flattened. Light mention highlight.

chip-dark.$description: apricot.300 at 30 % over grey.700, flattened. Dark mention chip.

chip-light.$description: apricot.300 at 28 % over grey.0, flattened. Light mention chip.

700.$description: Light online presence, positive text, success notice fill.

wash-dark.$description: green.500 at 16 % over dusk.235, flattened: the dark positive wash (Allow chosen).

wash-light.$description: green.500 at 8 % over white, flattened: the light positive wash.

400.$description: Dark idle presence, warning notice fill (both themes).

match-dark.$description: amber.400 at 28 % over dusk.235, flattened: the dark search match wash.

match-light.$description: amber.400 at 40 % over dusk.962, flattened: the light search match wash.

400.$description: Dark do-not-disturb presence and unread divider line. Discord's #F23F43 lightened to keep 3:1 on selected rows.

500.$description: Danger fill, mention badges and the NEW pill (white text 4.57:1), light do-not-disturb and divider.

wash-dark.$description: red.400 at 16 % over dusk.235, flattened: the dark danger wash (Sensitive tag, Deny chosen).

wash-light.$description: red.500 at 10 % over white, flattened: the light danger wash.

white.$description: Text on red, green and neutral fills.

peach.$description: Light peach: Melli's marks on dark surfaces.

shadow.$description: Warm brown at 15 %: a soft ground shadow on light surfaces and on apricot.

shadow-dark.$description: Black at 35 %: a ground shadow that still shows on the dark rail.

body-overcast.$description: Melli's cloud gone grey while the connection is lost.

ink.$description: Melli's eyes and every mark drawn around it.

blush.$description: Melli's cheeks when happy or excited (decorative).

tile-top.$description: App icon tile, top of the gradient (dusk sky).

tile-bottom.$description: App icon tile, bottom of the gradient.

tile-glow.$description: Apricot glow low on the tile, behind Melli: the low sun (55 %).

scrim-dark.$description: Dark scrim: the deepest dusk at 72 %.

shadow-medium-dark.$description: Hover bar and popover shadow, dark.

shadow-medium-light.$description: Hover bar and popover shadow, light.

shadow-high-dark.$description: Menus, tooltips and dialogs shadow, dark.

shadow-high-light.$description: Menus, tooltips and dialogs shadow, light.

avatar.$description: Default avatar tints from the Dusk mockup, each at least 4.5:1 with white initials.

color.$description: Tier 2. Semantic colours. $value is the dark theme (default); $extensions.org.mellow.theme.light is the light theme. Components use only this tier.

rail.$description: Ground: the server rail. Same tone as the sidebar, so the rail and the channel list read as one quiet room around the sheet (ADR-0022).

sidebar.$description: Ground: channel sidebar, member list, settings navigation.

sidebar-footer.$description: The user card: dark raised on the ground, light one step below the white navigator card it sits in (ADR-0022).

chat.$description: The sheet: message pane, chat header, settings content.

field.$description: Text fields in forms and settings (always with border.strong).

popover.$description: Profile popover, autocomplete, quick switcher, dialogs.

floating.$description: Context menus and tooltips (always with a hairline in dark).

navigator.$description: The navigator card (server strip, channels, user card) and the side sheet, floating on the ground (ADR-0022).

divider.$description: Decorative dividers and the hover bar outline. Never the only boundary of a control.

quote.$description: Block quote bar and reply spine. Decorative: quotes are also indented.

hover.$description: Hover on sidebar, member list and menu-less rows.

selected.$description: Selected channel, conversation, settings page; pressed rows.

heading.$description: Headers, author names, unread and selected channels.

normal.$description: Message text, menu items, hovered channels.

secondary.$description: Member names without role colour, interactive icons, topics.

muted.$description: Read channels, timestamps, category labels, placeholders, activity lines.

disabled.$description: Disabled controls only (exempt from contrast, always paired with a reason).

link.$description: Links (underlined on hover and focus, always underlined when the accessibility setting is on).

danger.$description: Error text, danger menu items, failed-send label.

accent.$description: Accent-coloured text wherever Discord uses blurple text, such as the 'Invite people' menu item.

on-accent.$description: Text and icons on accent fills.

on-danger.$description: Text on danger fills, badges, NEW pill.

on-neutral.$description: Text on neutral and positive fills.

fill.$description: Mellow's accent wherever Discord uses blurple: primary buttons, selected Home, hovered rail icon without artwork, focused menu item, jump bars.

indicator.$description: Apricot marks that must reach 3:1 on any surface: the selected rail pill, the unread divider, the mention bar (ADR-0022).

fill.$description: Destructive buttons, mention badges, NEW pill, danger menu item hover.

wash.$description: Quiet danger background under text.danger: the Sensitive permission tag, a chosen Deny.

fill.$description: Add-server icon and its hover fill, success notice.

wash.$description: Quiet positive background under text.positive: a chosen Allow.

fill.$description: Warning notice bar (text uses surface.rail dark grey).

background.$description: Background of a message that mentions you. Same value on hover.

bar.$description: 2 px bar on the leading edge of a message that mentions you.

line.$description: Unread divider rule: apricot, the colour of 'you' and 'now' (ADR-0022).

dnd.$description: Do-not-disturb presence (circle with a bar cut out).

scrim.$description: Behind dialogs and the narrow-window drawer.

mascot.$description: Melli, the Mellow mascot and logo (DESIGN.md §2.10). Brand artwork: the same in both themes.

shadow.$description: Ground shadow under Melli; translucent so it works on the rail and on apricot.

body.$description: The cloud, and the glints in excited eyes.

body-overcast.$description: The cloud in the connection-lost state.

ink.$description: Eyes and mouth on the cloud, and the state marks on apricot. At least 3:1 on the cloud and on apricot.

outline.$description: Melli's edge: the cloud has no tile behind it, so the outline keeps it whole on light surfaces and light docks.

mark.$description: State marks drawn around Melli (dots, drops, sparkle, rings, waves, arrow, Zzz) on the surface it sits on. At least 3:1 on the rail; on apricot the host switches marks to ink.

blush.$description: Cheeks when happy or excited. Decorative: never the only sign of a state.

tile-top.$description: App icon and favicon tile: top of the gradient.

tile-bottom.$description: App icon and favicon tile: bottom of the gradient.

tile-glow.$description: App icon and favicon tile: apricot glow behind Melli.

avatar.$description: Default avatars (no picture): one tint per person, picked from the user id (DESIGN.md 2.3), the initial in white.

background.$description: Words a search found, and the message a search result opened: the lamp held over the text. Never for 'you' or 'now' (apricot).

sans.$description: All UI and message text. Figtree, bundled variable font (OFL 1.1), weights 400-800 used; Noto Sans as fallback for scripts Figtree does not cover.

mono.$description: Inline code, code blocks, invite codes, IDs (OFL 1.1).

emoji.$description: Emoji. Twemoji graphics are CC-BY 4.0 (attribution in About). See DESIGN.md section 9.

type.$description: Sizes in logical px (sp on Android); lineHeight is a multiplier of fontSize. Message styles scale with 'Chat font size'; every style scales with 'Zoom level'. No text is smaller than 12 px at 100 %.

display.$description: Channel-start hero ('Welcome to #general'), first-run title (32/40 px).

heading-xl.$description: Sign-in and connect card titles (24/30 px).

heading-lg.$description: Dialog titles, settings page titles, quick switcher input (20/24 px).

heading-md.$description: Server name in sidebar header, channel name in chat header, popover display name (16/20 px).

body.$description: Descriptions, helper text, dialog body, channel topic (14/18 px).

body-sm.$description: Activity lines, user panel status, helper text under fields (12/16 px).

message.$description: Message text and composer text (16/22 px).

message-author.$description: Author name on the first message of a group (16/22 px).

message-timestamp.$description: Timestamp after the author name, hover timestamp in the gutter, '(edited)' (12/22 px).

message-h1.$description: Markdown heading 1 inside a message (24/30 px).

message-h2.$description: Markdown heading 2 inside a message (20/26 px).

message-h3.$description: Markdown heading 3 inside a message (16/22 px).

message-subtext.$description: Markdown subtext (-#) inside a message (12/16 px).

code.$description: Inline code and code blocks (14/18 px).

invite-code.$description: The invite code in "Invite people" (28/36 px, smaller only when its well is too narrow): Figtree at its heaviest, tracked out so its twelve symbols read one by one. Crockford's alphabet has no O, I, L or U, so the monospace face's 0/O and 1/l/I distinction is not needed; Figtree is bundled, so the code looks the same on every platform.

channel-name.$description: Channel and conversation names in the sidebar (16/20 px).

member-name.$description: Names in the member list (16/20 px).

category.$description: Category headers, member groups, settings section labels, form labels. Sentence case (ADR-0022): no uppercase transform.

user-panel-name.$description: Display name in the user panel (14/18 px).

badge.$description: Mention count badges and the NEW pill (12/16 px).

typing.$description: Typing indicator under the composer (14/24 px).

space.$description: 4 px grid. Odd Discord values (2, 6, 20) live in component tokens.

xs.$description: Mention chips, inline code, small tags.

sm.$description: Rows, buttons, tooltips, the hover bar, menu items' outer radius.

md.$description: Popovers, context menus, attachments, jump bars, the user card, settings cards.

lg.$description: The sheet, dialogs, the composer, the selected server squircle (at 48 px).

full.$description: Avatars, badges, status dots, resting server icons.

size.$description: Fixed layout dimensions in logical px (dp on Android). These are the dimension table of DESIGN.md section 4.2.

medium-width.$description: "Create a server": a form column beside the live preview (DESIGN.md §5.2).

desktop-min.$description: WCAG 2.5.8 floor; interactive desktop elements are 32 px or more in practice.

row-height.$description: Channel, conversation and member rows on Android (48 dp touch target).

row-highlight-height.$description: Visible hover/selected highlight inside a 48 dp row.

panel-peek.$description: Sliver of the chat panel left visible when the channel panel or member panel is open.

height.$description: Height of the composer's base row and of the user card, so their top and bottom edges line up.

margin.$description: Gap between the composer or the user card and the bottom edge of the card holding it.

inset.$description: Gap between the sheet and the window edges (top, trailing, bottom) on wide layouts; 0 below 792 px.

elevation.$description: Shadows. $value is dark; light in $extensions. Slint and Compose use the first layer only.

low.$description: 1 px line under the sidebar header and the chat header.

medium.$description: Message hover bar, popovers, jump bars.

high.$description: Context menus, tooltips, dialogs, quick switcher.

fast.$description: Hover and pressed colour changes, focus ring.

base.$description: Server icon squircle morph, rail pill height, category collapse, menus and tooltips.

slow.$description: Panels and drawers sliding, Android panel settle.

settle.$description: Spatial moves that land with a small overshoot (motion.easing.settle): dialog open, rail squircle, a sent message settling.

highlight.$description: Fade-out of the highlight on a message you jumped to.

tooltip-rail.$description: Rail tooltips appear immediately, as on Discord.

copied-label.$description: How long a Copy button reads 'Copied' before it reverts, as on Discord.

skeleton.$description: Before skeletons appear, to avoid flicker.

long-press.$description: How long a finger rests on a row before its context menu opens (touch only); kept under reduced motion, since it is a gesture, not an animation.

jump-highlight.$description: How long a message opened from a search result keeps its highlight; kept under reduced motion, where the highlight holds still and then goes.

settle.$description: Ease out with about 5 % overshoot: Melli's bounce, used only with motion.duration.settle. Slint: cubic-bezier with the same points, or ease-out-back. Never under reduced motion (durations are 0).

spring.$description: Android spring for the same moments as motion.easing.settle (Compose spring(dampingRatio, stiffness)).

component.$description: Tier 3. Component tokens, aliases of tier 2 (or of each other). Theme follows the alias, so no light extension is needed here.

icon-radius-active.$description: Squircle on hover, focus and selection.

icon-background-rest.$description: Servers without artwork at rest: visible on the navigator card in both themes.

icon-text-rest.$description: Initials and Home logo at rest.

icon-background-active.$description: Hovered or selected server without artwork. Home alone turns apricot.

pill-width.$description: Half of it (4 px) is visible; the rest sits off the leading edge.

pill-color-selected.$description: The tall pill beside the selected server: apricot, 'you are here' (ADR-0022). Unread and hover pills keep pill-color.

header-background-hover.$description: Server name header when it opens the server menu (DESIGN.md §5.3).

header-menu-margin.$description: Space between the server menu and the sidebar edges, and below the header.

add-icon-size.$description: The "+" beside a category (create a channel in it), in a button as tall as the category row.

gap.$description: Vertical gap between rows (34 px pitch).

unread-pill-width.$description: 4 px visible at the sidebar's leading edge.

unread-pill-offset.$description: From the pill's leading edge to the row's: the pill sits in the margin between the server strip and the row.

image-radius.$description: A channel icon in place of the # glyph: a rounded square, since circles are people.

trailing-icon-size.$description: The lock after the name of a read-only channel that shows its icon.

settings-button-size.$description: The gear (Edit channel) at the row's trailing end, shown on hover, focus and selection; 44 px under a coarse pointer.

muted-icon.$description: The bell-slash after a muted channel's or conversation's name: muted is never said by colour alone.

conversation-row.$description: Direct message rows on Home (DESIGN.md §5.6). Margins, colours, radius and unread pill are the channel-row ones, as on Discord.

group-avatar.$description: A group conversation's picture (DESIGN.md §5.6, ADR-0026): two participants' avatars leaning on each other, the front one cut out of the surface behind it.

face-scale.$description: Each face's share of the whole avatar's width.

ring-width.$description: The cut-out around the front face, in the colour of the surface behind.

empty-background.$description: A group where you are alone: the users glyph on a neutral disc.

member-count-text.$description: "4 members" under a group's name in the conversation list and after it in the chat header.

people-picker.$description: "New message" and "Add friends" (DESIGN.md §5.6, ADR-0026): chips for the friends chosen, a search field, then a list of friends with checkboxes.

list-max-height.$description: The list scrolls past this; the dialog itself never grows past the window.

row-height.$description: Name and username beside a 32 px avatar; at least the 44 px web target.

checkbox-color.$description: Apricot is "you": the friends you chose. The browser draws the check in a colour that contrasts with it.

search-min-width.$description: The search keeps the chips' row while this much room is left, else wraps under them.

button-background-hover.$description: One step above the user card, so the hover reads on it.

status-text-hover.$description: Second line while the avatar and name button is hovered or its status menu is open: muted text is under 4.5:1 on that wash in light.

update-badge.$description: Dot on the settings button while an app update is available or ready (DESIGN.md §5.3).

update-badge-ring-width.$description: Ring in the panel colour cut around the dot, as on presence dots.

button-icon-size.$description: Phosphor glyphs at 62.5 % of their 32 px button match Discord's 20-in-32.

radius.$description: The user card's radius inside the navigator card.

margin.$description: Same bottom gap as the composer, so both line up (size.dock.*).

toggle-muted-icon.$description: Microphone or headset icon while muted, with a strike-through (never colour alone).

toggle-strike-length.$description: Length of the strike-through across a muted microphone or headset icon.

toggle-strike-cut-width.$description: Gap in the card colour cut around the strike, so it reads over the icon.

divider-height.$description: Vertical rule between channel name and topic.

button-size.$description: Header icon buttons (member list toggle, search).

avatar-inset.$description: Avatar distance from the pane's leading edge.

group-gap.$description: Default of the 'Space between message groups' setting (0, 4, 8, 16, 20, 24).

history-load-distance.$description: Older history starts loading when the reader scrolls this close to the top of the loaded messages.

author-text.$description: Fallback when the author has no role colour.

reply-height.$description: The reply reference line above a reply's author; the avatar moves down by it.

reply-spine-radius.$description: Corner where the spine turns from the avatar towards the reference.

reply-spine-inline-size.$description: How far the spine runs from the avatar's centre towards the reply reference.

reply-spine-block-size.$description: How far the spine drops from the reference line towards the avatar.

spoiler-background.$description: Hidden spoiler in message text: a solid block at 3:1 against the sheet in both themes.

spoiler-revealed-background.$description: Revealed spoiler: a quiet tint behind normal text (8:1 or more in both themes).

compact-timestamp-width.$description: Compact mode timestamp column, starting at 16 px.

highlight-background.$description: A message opened from a search result, fading over motion.duration.highlight (held still under reduced motion).

selection-background.$description: Text selection highlight in per-message selection mode (focus colour at 35 %).

pending-text.$description: Body and "Sending…" label of a message the server has not confirmed yet.

failed-status-text.$description: Icon and "Not sent." under a message whose send failed; the body keeps body-text.

status-icon-size.$description: Icon before "Not sent.", sized to the 12 px status line.

editor-background.$description: Inline edit field that replaces the body of the message being edited.

editor-hint-gap.$description: Between the edit field and its "escape to cancel • enter to save" line.

skeleton-fill.$description: Static message skeletons (avatar circle, name and text bars) while history loads. Dark uses state.selected: state.hover is nearly invisible on surface.chat.

skeleton-bar-height.$description: Name and text bars; each sits centred in a line box of type.message's line height, so a skeleton is as tall as a real message.

skeleton-name-max-width.$description: Widest name bar; text bars are fractions of the text column instead.

channel-start-icon-circle-size.$description: Circle of the channel-start hero ('Welcome to #general').

channel-start-gap.$description: Between the hero's circle, title and sentences.

history-error-text.$description: "Couldn't load older messages." at the top of the list, or alone in an empty one.

enter-offset.$description: A new message at the bottom rises this far while it fades in.

blocked-text.$description: The collapsed row standing for messages from someone you blocked (DESIGN.md §5.4).

blocked-action-text.$description: Show and Hide read as Discord's links, but are buttons.

icon-danger-hover.$description: Delete icon on hover, as Discord turns its trash icon red.

background-hover.$description: Intentionally unchanged on hover so muted text keeps 4.5:1.

margin-bottom.$description: Gap under the composer's base row; the typing indicator sits above the composer (ADR-0022).

locked-text.$description: "You do not have permission to send messages in this channel." in place of the field (DESIGN.md §5.5); 4.80 / 5.51 on surface.input.

typing-dot-size.$description: The three dots of the typing indicator.

typing-dot-lift.$description: How far each dot rises at the top of its wave.

typing-dot-duration.$description: One wave of the typing dots; it loops only while someone types, and stops under reduced motion.

typing-dot-stagger.$description: Delay between one dot and the next.

reply-bar-background.$description: "Replying to Ana" bar attached above the composer field (DESIGN.md §5.5).

reply-bar-min-height.$description: Fits the 32 px close button with a 2 px margin.

error-text.$description: Message action errors (edit or delete failed) shown above the composer.

reply-bar-icon-size.$description: Phosphor glyphs at 62.5 % of their 32 px button match Discord's 20-in-32.

attach-button-size.$description: Attach button (plus-circle) at the leading end of the field (DESIGN.md §5.5).

tray-padding.$description: Attachment tray inside the composer box, above the field (DESIGN.md §5.5).

tray-divider.$description: Line between the tray and the field, as on Discord.

tray-item-preview-height.$description: Thumbnail or file icon area, 4:3 of the item width.

tray-item-error-border.$description: 1 px outline of an item whose upload failed; the warning icon and sentence carry the state too.

tray-item-uploading-opacity.$description: Thumbnail and file icon while the file uploads; "Uploading…" says it in words.

tray-item-remove-offset.$description: Remove button inset from the item's top trailing corner; it uses the action-bar button tokens.

typing-dot-opacity-peak.$description: A typing dot at the top of its wave.

typing-dot-opacity-still.$description: The dots under reduced motion: still, and clearly visible.

gap.$description: Between attachments, and between the text and the first one.

image-placeholder.$description: Block shown while an image loads; the instance does not send a dominant colour.

file-icon.$description: Mellow's apricot where Discord colours its file glyph; decorative, the name says what it is.

file-name-text.$description: The file name is the download link.

row-icon-size.$description: Desktop: file icon of the compact "name · size" rows under a message.

drop-overlay.$description: "Drop to attach to #general" over the chat pane while files are dragged (DESIGN.md §5.5).

border-width.$description: Dashed inner outline marking the drop zone.

background.$description: The member list lives in the side sheet.

group-height.$description: Group header height; label sits at the bottom.

name-text.$description: Fallback when the member has no role colour.

offline-avatar-opacity.$description: Offline members dim the avatar only; text keeps full contrast.

size-menu.$description: Beside the status names in the user card's status menu (DESIGN.md §5.3).

ring-width.$description: Cut-out ring in the colour of the surface the avatar sits on.
Cut-out ring in the colour of the parent surface.

item-radius.$description: Concentric with the menu: menu radius minus its padding.

item-hint-text-focus.$description: Sublabels on a hovered item: muted text is under 4.5:1 on state.selected in light.

item-background-focus.$description: Quiet focus: apricot stays for 'you' and 'now' (ADR-0022).

accent-text.$description: Highlighted item ('Invite people'), as on Discord; hover uses the item-*-focus pair.

border.$description: Outline that separates the menu from the surface below where shadows are not generated (Slint).

item-icon-size.$description: Trailing icon of a menu item, as in Discord's server menu.

long-press-move-tolerance.$description: How far a finger may drift during a long press before it counts as scrolling or selecting, and the menu does not open.

viewport-margin.$description: The least room a menu keeps from the window's edges when it opens at the pointer.

profile-popover.$description: Member profile popout opened from the member list (DESIGN.md §5.7).

border.$description: Outline instead of elevation.high, which Slint does not generate.

offset.$description: Gap between the popout and the member list it opens from.

banner.$description: Default banner strip until profiles carry an accent colour; decorative.

banner-image-height.$description: Strip height when the user has a banner picture: Discord's 5:2 banner across the 300 px card (ADR-0021).

avatar-ring-width.$description: Ring of the popover colour cut around the avatar where it overlaps the banner.

text-gap.$description: Between the name, username and the Message button (web).

disabled-opacity.$description: Disabled and busy buttons, as on Discord; the label still says what is happening.

dialog.$description: Modal confirmation dialog (DESIGN.md §6.35): surface.chat body, surface.sidebar footer with the buttons, on a full-window scrim.

width-wide.$description: Dialogs with two columns; narrower windows stack them.

margin.$description: Minimum space between the dialog and the window edges on narrow windows.

preview-body-max-height.$description: Long messages are cut in the preview; the dialog never outgrows the window.

subtitle-gap.$description: Between the title and the sentence under it.

error-text.$description: Failed action, under the form; always with the warning icon.

mode-link-text.$description: 'Join a server' / 'Create a server' switch in the add-server dialog, like the sign-in mode switch.

enter-scale.$description: Dialogs grow from 96 % to full size while fading in.

nav-width.$description: Navigation column, right-aligned in the sidebar on wide windows.

nav-danger-background-hover.$description: Danger item hover, as danger context menu items: text.danger on state.hover misses 4.5:1 in the light theme.

content-padding-inline-narrow.$description: Below the sidebar breakpoint (DESIGN.md §4.2), so the page keeps room for its text.

account-card-background.$description: My Account card: Discord's inner account card, one step off the page.

notice-text.$description: Success sentence after a check icon, so it never relies on colour alone.

tabs.$description: Tabs (DESIGN.md §6.45): text tabs over a divider, the selected one underlined in the accent.

indicator.$description: accent.fill is 2.59:1 on light surface.chat; the pressed shade passes 3:1 in both themes.

switch.$description: Switch (DESIGN.md §6.5): check glyph on the knob when on, cross when off, so state never relies on colour.

track-off.$description: Below 3:1 on dark surfaces, as on Discord: there the white knob marks the control; in light the track itself passes.

disabled-opacity.$description: Locked permissions; the editor also says why.

unsaved-bar.$description: Unsaved changes bar at the bottom of settings content (DESIGN.md §5.8, §6.44).

border.$description: Outline instead of elevation.high, which Slint does not generate.

shake-step-duration.$description: One swing of the shake; six swings in all.

shake-swing-count.$description: Swings of the shake, each smaller than the last.

list-gap.$description: Between the role list and the editor.

neutral-color.$description: Dot and swatch of a role without colour, like Discord's default grey.

move-button-size.$description: WCAG 2.5.8 floor; the keyboard shortcut and the row stay the larger targets.

move-button-background-hover.$description: Over a hovered row, so one step brighter than state.hover.

editor-gap.$description: Between fields and sections of the editor.

swatch-ring.$description: Selected swatch, with the check plate; never colour alone.

swatch-check-plate.$description: Behind the check, so it reads on any role colour.

permission-gap.$description: Between the texts and the switch.

permission-group-gap.$description: Above each group header but the first.

error-text.$description: Failed role action, above the editor.

server-settings.$description: Lists of the web server settings (DESIGN.md §5.8): members, bans, invites and the moderation log, with role chips and loading rows.

row-min-height.$description: A list row: the avatar and two lines of text, or one line and a 44 px button.

row-gap.$description: Between the avatar, the texts and the row's actions.

text-gap.$description: Between a row's name and its second line.

secondary-text.$description: Second lines: usernames, dates, uses, reasons.

code-text.$description: Invite codes, in the monospace family.

toolbar-gap.$description: Between the search field or the main action and the list below.

chip-gap.$description: Between chips, and between a chip's dot and its name.

chip-text.$description: text.heading on state.selected passes 4.5:1 in both themes.

chip-dot-size.$description: The role colour; a role without one shows color.text.muted.

skeleton-fill.$description: Static loading rows (avatar circle and text bars), as the message skeletons.

chip-role-tint.$description: Share of a role's own colour mixed into a role chip's background: the chip carries its role's hue, quietly enough that text.heading stays above 6:1 for any colour.

chip-owner-icon.$description: The crown of the Owner chip.

channel-settings.$description: Channel settings (DESIGN.md §5.8): the overwrite list and the three-way Deny / Inherit / Allow control of each channel permission.

target-avatar-size.$description: Members in the overwrite list, beside the role dots.

override-height.$description: The Deny / Inherit / Allow control; 44 px under a coarse pointer.

override-border.$description: The control's outline: 3:1 against the page in both themes.

override-text.$description: Options not chosen: label and glyph.

override-background-selected.$description: The chosen Inherit, with its label in text.heading; a chosen Deny or Allow takes its own wash and text colour, its word and glyph still saying it.

override-deny-background-selected.$description: A chosen Deny reads as a refusal at a glance.

override-allow-background-selected.$description: A chosen Allow reads as a grant at a glance.

auth-card.$description: Sign-in and register card on a full-window backdrop, as Discord's authentication pages (DESIGN.md §5.1).

max-width.$description: Card width on wide windows; narrower windows shrink it to keep margin-inline on each side.

margin.$description: Minimum gap between the card and the window edges, also when the card scrolls.

section-gap.$description: Between the heading block, the form and the primary button.

hint-text.$description: "Need an account?" before the mode switch link.

link-underline-width.$description: Hover underline of the mode switch link; Slint has no text decoration.

melli-size.$description: Melli above the sign-in title: the screen's one bold element (ADR-0022).

melli-overlap.$description: Share of Melli's height above the card's top edge: Melli sits on the card, mostly above it.

text-field.$description: Form text field (DESIGN.md §6.3): uppercase label above, outlined field, optional helper line below.

height.$description: Discord uses 40; 44 keeps the whole field a comfortable pointer and touch target.

field-gap.$description: Between consecutive fields of a form.

notice-bar.$description: Full-width strip at the top of the window, as Discord's notices (DESIGN.md §6.37).

invite-background.$description: The one-time notification permission bar: the apricot wash of what is for you, never the amber of a warning.

invite-bar.$description: Leading edge of the permission bar, like a mention's.

melli.$description: Melli's timings (DESIGN.md §2.10). Shapes and keyframe amplitudes are part of the drawing and live with it.

float-duration.$description: Idle float and its shadow, one cycle.

puff-spin-duration.$description: One full turn of the puffs.

wait-duration.$description: Connecting: the three dots, one cycle.

hop-duration.$description: Notification: one twinkle of the sparkles on the web (the desktop still hops on this cycle).

ring-duration.$description: Incoming call: one ring (a burst of rocking, then a pause).

talk-duration.$description: In a call: the calm bob and the sound waves.

excited-duration.$description: Update available: the double bounce and the arrow.

sleep-duration.$description: Sleeping: one breath and one Z drifting up.

chime-duration.$description: The chime, once per alert: a hop with happy eyes and a bell swinging beside the head (web).

state-change-duration.$description: Poses, colours and marks easing from one state to the next.

background.$description: The navigator card: server strip, channels and user card in one floating card.

strip-width.$description: The server strip inside the navigator.

enter-offset.$description: The navigator drawer slides in from this far beyond the leading edge.

background.$description: Members, profiles and later threads, beside or over the sheet.

enter-offset.$description: The side sheet slides in from this far towards the trailing edge.

radius.$description: Corner radius of the sheet where it meets the ground.

offset.$description: The incoming channel's messages rise this far while they fade in.

quick-switcher.$description: The quick switcher (DESIGN.md 5.10): Ctrl+K, or "Go to… Ctrl K" in the chat header beside message search.

input-height.$description: The large search field, in type.heading-lg.

offset-top.$description: Share of the window height above the dialog: it opens high, near where the eye is (as in the mockup, 12 vh).

results-max-height.$description: Share of the window height the results may take before they scroll (50 vh).

input-icon-size.$description: The magnifier inside the switcher's large field, at the size of its type.

input-gap.$description: Between the magnifier and the typed text.

trigger-width.$description: The chat header's "Go to… Ctrl K" field at rest while message search is a button; beside the search field it takes its content's width.

trigger-icon.$description: The magnifier of the header's "Go to…" field; text.secondary on hover.

trigger-collapse-width.$description: Below this chat header width (phones, or a sheet docked beside a narrow chat), "Go to…" becomes a compass button so the channel name keeps its room.

reaction.$description: Reaction chips under a message (DESIGN.md 5.4): emoji and count; yours take the apricot wash and edge, since apricot is "you" (ADR-0022).

height.$description: Grows to size.hit.web-min under a coarse pointer.

gap.$description: Between the emoji and its count.

border.$description: Same as the background: the edge only shows on yours and on hover.

pinned-icon.$description: The pin beside a pinned message's text.

emoji-picker.$description: The emoji picker (DESIGN.md 6.52): search, recently used, then categories of a built-in set.

height.$description: At most; on phones the picker takes the window's width.

cell-size.$description: Grows to size.hit.web-min under a coarse pointer.

emoji-size-coarse.$description: Under a coarse pointer the cells are 44 px, so the emoji grow with them.

category-size.$description: A category button in the bar under the search; size.hit.web-min under a coarse pointer.

category-icon-current.$description: The category being read, as the list scrolls.

custom-emoji.$description: A server's own emoji (DESIGN.md 6.58, ADR-0028): pictures inline in messages, alone and larger (jumbo), in reaction chips, in the picker and the composer's suggestions, and in server settings.

inline-size.$description: In a line of message text, as on Discord (1.375 times the message size).

jumbo-size.$description: A message made only of emoji (up to 30) shows them at this size, Unicode emoji included.

missing-border.$description: The dashed outline standing in for a deleted emoji's picture in a reaction chip.

suggestion-width.$description: The ":na" suggestions above the composer, at most; the composer's width on phones.

suggestion-max-height.$description: Nine rows of context-menu.item-height, then the list scrolls.

settings-picture-background.$description: A tile under each picture, so transparent emoji keep one shape in the list.

settings-name-max-width.$description: The in-place rename field: room for a 32-character name, no wider.

settings-name-border-hover.$description: The rename field shows its edge on hover only; focus shows the focus ring.

settings-count-full-text.$description: "50 / 50" once a kind is full, with the word "Full" so it is not told by colour alone.

pins.$description: The pinned messages panel, opened from the chat header (DESIGN.md 6.53).

icon-picker.$description: Server and channel icon editor with its square crop dialog (DESIGN.md §6.54).

preview-size.$description: The current icon on the Overview page.

preview-radius-channel.$description: Channel icons are rounded squares; server icons are circles at rest, as in the strip.

preview-background.$description: Behind the initials or the # glyph when there is no icon.

stage-background.$description: Behind a picture that does not fill the crop stage.

frame-inset.$description: Between the stage's edge and the square that will be kept: the dimmed picture around it keeps its context.

frame-border.$description: White in both themes, on a picture of any colour; the scrim outside gives it its contrast.

outside-scrim.$description: Over the part of the picture that is cut away.

sample-gap.$description: Between the samples at their real size.

choice.$description: A radio row in a dialog (DESIGN.md §6.55): a channel type, a server template, a destination category. Native radio in accent.indicator (your choice), a name and an optional one-line description; checked rows are washed and edged, so the choice never relies on the dot alone.

gap.$description: Between the radio, the icon and the text.

description-text-checked.$description: Muted text is not checked on the selected wash.

channel-drag.$description: Reordering channels and categories in the sidebar by drag and drop (DESIGN.md §5.3): the row lifts into the floating layer, an apricot line says where it lands ("you, now"), a washed header takes it into a category.

start-distance.$description: A mouse or pen press becomes a drag past this; touch needs the long-press hold first.

indicator-dot-size.$description: A ring at the line's leading end, so the line reads as a place, not a divider.

source-opacity.$description: The row's old place while it is carried, so the list does not jump.

lift-scale.$description: The one motion of a drag, over motion.duration.fast with the settle curve; none under reduced motion.

autoscroll-edge.$description: Within this of the list's top or bottom, the list scrolls under the carried row.

autoscroll-step.$description: Per frame at the very edge, less further in.

server-preview.$description: The live preview of "Create a server" (DESIGN.md §5.2): the navigator card in miniature, built from the sidebar's own tokens and type at their real size.

max-height.$description: Longer templates are cut at the card's foot, as a long sidebar would be.

friends.$description: The Friends space at Home (DESIGN.md §5.6.1): the tabs, friend rows with round actions, Add friend, and Melli in the empty states.

row-height.$description: Two lines beside a 32 px avatar; Discord's 62 rounded to the 4 px grid.

row-background-hover.$description: The sheet's own hover wash, as on messages: muted text keeps 4.5:1 on it.

detail-text.$description: Custom status, or what a pending or blocked row is.

group-height.$description: As the member list's group headers.

action-size.$description: Round, as Discord's; 44 px under a coarse pointer.

action-icon-positive-hover.$description: Accept: green, as Discord's check turns.

action-icon-danger-hover.$description: Ignore, cancel: red, as the message bar's delete.

add-tab-background.$description: Add friend is the screen's one apricot fill (ADR-0022 §2), Discord's green button.

add-tab-text-selected.$description: Once open, the tab drops its fill: the Send button below takes it.

username-min-width.$description: Below this, Send friend request wraps under the field (phones).

content-max-width.$description: Add friend's field and sentences keep a readable line.

invite.$description: Invite people (DESIGN.md §5.3, §6.57): the code in a well, read as three groups, with the invite's limits below.

code-background.$description: A well sunk into the dialog: the code is the thing to take away.

code-dash-text.$description: The dashes between groups step back, so the groups read as three words.

stack-gap.$description: Between the well, the Copy button and the limits sentence.

select-icon.$description: The caret of a select field ("Expire after", "Maximum uses").

field-basis.$description: Each limit select grows from this width: side by side in a 440 px dialog, stacked on a phone.

code-width-in-em.$description: The code's width in em at type.invite-code (about 9.7 for twelve symbols and two dashes): on a phone the code shrinks to fit its well on one line instead of breaking.

permission-badge.$description: Tags beside a permission's name (DESIGN.md 6.42): today only "Sensitive".

search.$description: Message search (DESIGN.md 5.12): the header's field, its suggestions, the results side sheet and the matched words.

field-width.$description: The chat header's search field at rest; it gives way to the topic down to field-min-width.

field-width-active.$description: The field while it has focus or holds a query.

suggestions-width.$description: At least this wide, under the field; never wider than the window.

panel-width.$description: The results side sheet, docked when the window fits it beside the navigator and a 480 px conversation.

result-background.$description: A result is a slip of the conversation sheet on the side sheet's ground.

facet-height.$description: Facet and filter chips; 44 px under a coarse pointer.
